2: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. All you peoples, clap your hands. Shout to God with a voice of rejoicing.
3: For Yahweh Most High is awesome, a great king over all the earth.
4: He subdues peoples under us and nations under our feet.
5: He chooses for us our inheritance, the pride of Jacob whom he loves.
6: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
7: Sing praises to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our king, sing praises.
8: For God is king of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
9: God reigns over nations; God sits on his holy throne.
10: The princes of the peoples are gathered together with the people of Abraham’s God. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is very exalted.
